import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n

    sol = 0

    if m < 3:
        print(sol)
        return

    if n == 1:
        sol = m % 6
        if sol > 3:
            sol = 6 - sol
        print(m - sol)
        return

    if n == 2:
        sol = m * n
        if m == 3:
            sol = 4
        if m == 7:
            sol = 12
    elif n == 3:
        sol = m * n
        if m % 2 == 1:
            sol -= 1
    else:
        if m % 2 == 1 and n % 2 == 1:
            sol = m * n - 1
        else:
            sol = m * n

    print(sol)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
